Two free resources may be useful in an "External links" section, if editors think they meet [[WP:EL]]: * An open-source (MIT) script that lists every PHP installation on a server and flags PHP-FPM processes still running a replaced binary after the update: https://github.com/KyleClouthier/php2shell-check * A browser check that reads a site's public signals (headers, CMS fingerprints) and explains what to ask the host if the version is hidden: https://simgen.dev/php-patch-check .
